text: You've just spent the night sleeping face-down in a plate of synth-spaghetti in a bar called the Chatsubo. After rubbing the sauce out of your eyes, you can see Chiba sky through the window, the color of television tuned to a dead channel.A PAX booth is on the wall. Ratz's prosthetic Russian arm whines as he wipes the bar.  His teeth are a webwork of East European steel and brown decay.
In the Chatsubo Bar.
I don't care if you eat that spaghettior sleep in it, you still gotta payfor it.  46 credits.
Sorry, Ratz. I can't afford it. Wantme to give it back?
How about if I owe it to you?  You cantrust me.
I'm ready for dessert. Have you gotany pudding for me to sleep in?
I'd like to sleep on it some more,if that's okay with you, Ratz.
Pay up, cyberscum. Use the PAX if youneed money.
You been sleepin' in that stuff allnight. Now pay up or I call a lawbot.
I'll give ya 5 minutes to pay up, oryou're outta here.  Use the PAX.
Time's up, lowlife.  Nobody stiffs meand gets away with it!  I'm callin'the lawbot.
Thanks, friend artiste. Shin came by,but he didn't want to interrupt yourbeauty sleep. He still has your deck.
Who you calling an artiste?
What deck does Shin have?
Anything else come up?
You are the artiste of the slightlyfunny deal, Herr .
Your Yamamitsu UXB, Herr .Shin says you pawned it at his shop.
Somebody's gotta be funny around here.Sure the fuck isn't you.
Oh.  THAT deck.
One of Lonny Zone's girls was lookingfor you too. You got biz with Zone?
First Shin and now this. What kindacreepjoint you running here, Ratz?
Zone's a friend of mine, but I don'tknow why you let him run his biz here.
Zone shows a percentage. You I letwork here for entertainment value.
Did I hear something about the HealthDepartment closing this place?
Anything else you want to tell me?
A minor problem, friend artiste. I'llbe back in business within the week.
Better find a way to pay your bill atCheap Hotel, or they'll start askingyou to sell your body parts.
So I sell a kidney or two.  Why don'tyou get off my case, Ratz?
That's it.  I'm leaving.
You should have fear, artiste. It maybe your friend. Now get out of herebefore the lawbot arrives.
Good luck, artiste. You're going toneed it.
I said 46 credits, buckwheat. Are youdeaf?
Ratz refuses to take your credits.
